verdict.rationale: The product documents two of the story's distribution routes: a Claude Code plugin marketplace install, and project-local skills copied into the repo's `.claude/skills/` folder, which can be committed so the whole team gets the same set. Evidence is only claimed docs, and nothing addresses team-wide rollout or version management. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that marketplace and project-local installs work for a team, and guidance on team-wide pinning or updates of the skill set.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can distribute a standard skill set to my whole team — via a marketplace, a shared repo, or files committed to the project

citations.quote: Project-local instead of global: copy the same folders into your repo's `.claude/skills/`.
